import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tarfile
import time

repo = Path.cwd()
root = repo / "_build/generation-bottleneck"
archive = root / "tracked.tar"
subprocess.run(["git", "archive", "-o", str(archive), "HEAD"], check=True)
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
before = root / "generate_bundle.before.sh"
candidate = root / "generate_bundle.candidate.sh"
assert before.read_bytes() == subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "HEAD:scripts/generate_bundle.sh"])
assert candidate.read_bytes() == (repo / "scripts/generate_bundle.sh").read_bytes()
products = ["compiler_sources_bundle.vibe", "cli_adapter_bundle.vibe",
            "selfbuild_runtime_entry_bundle.vibe", "_cli_adapter_module_source.vibe",
            "cache/codegen_fingerprint.vibe"]
report = {
    "protocol": "three alternating AB/BA pairs; a=before, b=batching; separate equal-length project roots per pair; cold merge tool then warm; persistent guest artifact cache disabled; actual seed validation retained; compare all five generated products",
    "source_commit": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
    "before_script_sha256": sha(before),
    "candidate_script_sha256": sha(candidate),
    "candidate_helper_sha256": sha(repo / "scripts/bundle_source_functions.py"),
    "candidate_freshness_script_sha256": sha(repo / "scripts/ensure_generated.sh"),
    "seed_sha256": sha(repo / "bootstrap/seed/compiler.wasm"),
    "node_version": subprocess.check_output(["node", "--version"], text=True).strip(),
    "samples": [],
}
initial = {name: sha(repo / "lib/@vibe/compiler" / name) for name in products}
report["initial_generated_products_sha256"] = initial
report["protocol"] += "; both project trees receive the same initial generated library products"
expected = None
for pair in range(3):
    for lane in ("a", "b") if pair % 2 == 0 else ("b", "a"):
        checkout = root / f"pair-{pair}" / lane
        assert not checkout.exists(), checkout
        checkout.mkdir(parents=True)
        with tarfile.open(archive) as files:
            files.extractall(checkout, filter="data")
        shutil.copyfile(before if lane == "a" else candidate,
                        checkout / "scripts/generate_bundle.sh")
        if lane == "b":
            for name in ("bundle_source_functions.py", "ensure_generated.sh"):
                shutil.copyfile(repo / "scripts" / name, checkout / "scripts" / name)
        for name in products:
            destination = checkout / "lib/@vibe/compiler" / name
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copyfile(repo / "lib/@vibe/compiler" / name, destination)
        seed = checkout / "bootstrap/seed/compiler.wasm"
        seed.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(repo / "bootstrap/seed/compiler.wasm", seed)
        tool = checkout / "_build/merge_flatten_compiler.wasm"
        assert not tool.exists()
        for temperature in ("cold", "warm"):
            trace = checkout / f"{temperature}.trace.jsonl"
            log = checkout / f"{temperature}.log"
            env = {**os.environ, "VIBE_PROJECT_ROOT": str(checkout),
                   "VIBE_COMPILER_DIR": str(checkout / "lib/@vibe/compiler"),
                   "VIBE_SOURCE_MANIFEST": str(checkout / "lib/@vibe/compiler/compiler_sources_manifest.tsv"),
                   "VIBE_ADAPTER_MODULE_SOURCE_OUT": str(checkout / "lib/@vibe/compiler/_cli_adapter_module_source.vibe"),
                   "VIBE_BUILD_CACHE_DIR": str(checkout / "guest-cache"),
                   "VIBE_NATIVE_CACHE_DIR": str(checkout / "native-cache"),
                   "VIBE_DISABLE_PERSISTENT_ARTIFACT_CACHE": "1",
                   "VIBE_TRACE_OUT": str(trace)}
            start = time.monotonic()
            with log.open("w") as output:
                result = subprocess.run(["bash", "scripts/generate_bundle.sh"],
                                        cwd=checkout, env=env, stdout=output,
                                        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            seconds = time.monotonic() - start
            assert result.returncode == 0, log.read_text()[-3000:]
            hashes = {name: sha(checkout / "lib/@vibe/compiler" / name) for name in products}
            if expected is None:
                expected = hashes
            assert hashes == expected, (pair, lane, temperature, hashes, expected)
            assert tool.is_file()
            row = {"pair": pair, "lane": lane, "temperature": temperature,
                   "seconds": seconds, "returncode": result.returncode,
                   "products_sha256": hashes, "merge_tool_sha256": sha(tool),
                   "output": log.read_text(),
                   "spans": [json.loads(line) for line in trace.read_text().splitlines()]}
            report["samples"].append(row)
            (root / "bundle-comparison.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
            print(json.dumps({k: row[k] for k in ["pair", "lane", "temperature", "seconds"]}), flush=True)
assert len(report["samples"]) == 12
